Requirement Statement: The system shall prevent overlapping transactions on the shared PB8/PB9 communication bus from interfering with MPU6050 or OLED communications.
Source Text / Evidence:
MPU6050 SCL PB8 (shared with OLED)
 MPU6050 SDA PB9 (shared with OLED)
 OLED SCL PB8 (shared with MPU6050)
 OLED SDA PB9 (shared with MPU6050)
Inference Rationale: The MPU6050 and OLED share both signal pins. Without coordinated bus transactions, activity for one device can disrupt communication with the other, preventing reliable sensor acquisition or display updates.
Acceptance Criteria: Concurrent or back-to-back requests to the MPU6050 and OLED do not cause a bus transaction to be corrupted or misdirected.
Preconditions: The MPU6050 and OLED are connected to the shared PB8/PB9 signal lines.
Postconditions / Expected Behavior: Communications with both devices remain functional during concurrent system operation.
Comments / Open Questions: The PRD does not specify the bus protocol or transaction timing.

Requirement Statement: The system shall not evaluate sudden-change event thresholds until the 1-second power-up acceleration calibration is complete.
Source Text / Evidence: At power-up, keep the board flat and still for 1 s so the readings are zeroed (X = 0 g, Y = 0 g, Z = 1 g).

Acceptance Criteria: No sudden-change event is generated from acceleration data before completion of the 1-second calibration; threshold evaluation can occur after calibration completes.
Preconditions: The system has powered up and calibration is in progress.
Postconditions / Expected Behavior: Sudden-change event evaluation begins only after calibration completes.
